newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel puts fresh troops at Nablus shrine.
newsitem.headline: Israel puts fresh troops at Nablus shrine.

text.p: Israel, in coordination with Palestinian police, replaced its troops at a shrine in the Nablus Palestinian self-rule enclave that was a focus of bloody clashes between the sides on Thursday, the army said on Friday.
It said the several dozen troops were replaced by fresh forces after senior Israeli and Palestinian officers met overnight.
The Israeli army said 11 of its soldiers were killed by gunfire on Thursday, six during a siege of the domed tomb of the biblical Joseph in the heart of Palestinian-ruled Nablus in the West Bank.

The Palestinian Authority's health ministry said 39 Palestinians died on Thursday, raising to 44 the number killed in two days of gunfights unprecedented in the two years since PLO leader Yasser Arafat returned to run self-rule areas under peace deals with Israel.
